messages.subject: inla.posterior.sample()
parts:
Dear INLA-users,

I was running the inla.posterior.sample() function and got "Predictor:1" "Predictor:2" "Predictor:3" "Predictor:4" ...in the output $latent. What are the values of these Predictors?

Thanks,

Uta

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] inla.posterior.sample()
parts:
the example is here:

data(Germany)
g = system.file("demodata/germany.graph", package="INLA")
source(system.file("demodata/Bym-map.R", package="INLA"))
Germany = cbind(Germany,region.struct=Germany$region)
formula = Y ~ f(region.struct,model="besag",graph=g) +
f(region,model="iid")
r = inla(formula,family="poisson",data=Germany,E=E,
control.compute = list(config = TRUE))

xx <- inla.posterior.sample(1000, r)
xx.s <- inla.posterior.sample.eval(function() Predictor, xx)

str(xx.s)
